opportunities.title: Cyber Security Services 3
opportunities.category: IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support
opportunities.description: Crown Commercial Service (CCS) set up a dynamic purchasing system for a period of 60 months and has invited bidders to request to participate for the Cyber Security Services 3 DPS. This DPS provides central government departments and the wider public sector with the opportunity to procure cyber services from a range of suppliers. The DPS filters are for certification, services, standards and experience. Appointed suppliers will be invited by customers (buyers) to submit tenders for relevant services through a call for competition. This notice is to advise that this DPS has been further extended to 13/02/2029 and based on current spend profiling the estimated total value will remain as GBP 800million.

opportunities.title: Cornwall College Camborne - Trevithick Court Windows and Doors
opportunities.description: The Cornwall College Group will be issuing a tender for the following works on its Cornwall College Camborne campus (Trevenson Road, Pool, Redruth TR15 3RD), which will be released w/c 25 January 2027: • Design, supply and replace doors and windows for the internal courtyard corridor of the Trevithick Court building. There is a client brief confirming the preferred layout and materials. • The current structure is timber; pillars and other elements within the existing frame are structural, supporting the roof of the building. A structural report confirms the supporting elements, but the appointed contractor will need to ensure temporary works are in place to prop the existing structure while rotten sections are repaired/strengthened/replaced and the existing doors/windows removed and replaced with new (as agreed in the design stage). This will require the services of a structural engineer, which is expected to be facilitated and managed by the appointed contractor. • The works will be required to take place over the summer break 2027 (5th July to 3rd September 2027) and one local contractor (within two hours normal travelling distance from their base/office) is sought to act as Principal Designer/Contractor to carry out the works indicated above. • One contractor will be appointed to handle the design, supply and installation and the contract will not be split. • The contract will commence on 13/04/2027 due to the design aspect, structural elements, and material lead times. • The estimated value of the project is approx. GBP 100,000 to GBP 125,000 plus VAT. The colleges electronic Tender Portal InTend will be used for all Correspondence and Tender Submissions Registering your company on In-Tend Supplier Side https://in-tendhost.co.uk/cornwall/aspx/Home • Overview of Portal • Intro to Project Summary Page/ Correspondence box Useful Contact Information: In-Tend Helpdesk 0845 5578079 email: support@in-tend.co.uk
